subsystems.name: Sensing subsystem
subsystems.role: measures sunlight intensity, direction, temperature and wind to decide how the facade should move.

subsystems.name: Control subsystem
subsystems.role: processes sensor data and sends commands to the actuators, often integrating with the building management system.

subsystems.name: Actuation subsystem
subsystems.role: converts electrical signals into precise mechanical motion.

subsystems.name: Kinetic facade elements
subsystems.role: the moving surface that shades, reflects or redirects sunlight.

subsystems.name: Structural support
subsystems.role: carries the weight and wind loads of the moving elements and anchors them to the building.

subsystems.name: Power and data distribution
subsystems.role: supplies electricity and communication to every unit along the facade.

buildSteps.title: Design and simulate
buildSteps.detail: Model the building's sun exposure over a year, choose panel size, orientation and range of motion to cut cooling loads while keeping useful daylight.

buildSteps.title: Prototype and test
buildSteps.detail: Build a full-scale bay and run it through thousands of movement cycles to check actuators, hinges and weather sealing.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate components
buildSteps.detail: Cut and assemble panels, frames and linkages in a factory; program motor controllers and test each unit.

buildSteps.title: Install support frame
buildSteps.detail: Anchor rails and brackets to the building structure, ensuring alignment and load capacity for wind and weight.

buildSteps.title: Mount kinetic units
buildSteps.detail: Attach panels to hinges and actuators, adjusting for smooth, quiet movement across the full range.

buildSteps.title: Wire sensors and actuators
buildSteps.detail: Run power and data cables along the facade, connect to junction boxes and the central control panel.

buildSteps.title: Commission control system
buildSteps.detail: Configure algorithms for sun tracking, wind safety and manual override; integrate with the building management system.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and test
buildSteps.detail: Verify full range of motion, response times and fail-safe positions; measure energy savings against a fixed facade.

buildSteps.title: Maintain
buildSteps.detail: Schedule inspections, lubrication and replacement of worn parts to keep the facade moving reliably for decades.

prerequisites.why: they provide the precise, repeatable motion needed to reposition panels many times a day.
they give the control system real-time data to respond to changing conditions.
they interpret sensor data and command the actuators without constant human input.
aluminium and composites keep moving parts light and resistant to weather.
it coordinates the facade with heating, cooling and lighting for maximum efficiency.

pathway.milestone: motorised louvers and panels on some commercial buildings, mainly in hot sunny climates
pathway.unlocks: reduced cooling loads and glare without blocking views entirely.

pathway.milestone: cheaper sensors and actuators make kinetic facades affordable for retrofits
pathway.unlocks: wider adoption in existing office and residential towers.

pathway.milestone: integration with smart grids and demand response
pathway.unlocks: facades that adjust shading to manage building load and support grid stability.

pathway.milestone: energy-generating kinetic facades using solar panels or piezoelectric elements on moving parts
pathway.unlocks: buildings that produce some of their own power while adapting to the sun.
